item.description:

item.title: [Sat, Nov 28] Yoga with Lauren
item.description: 🎫 KOTO 📍 Wilkinson Public Library, Telluride Move, breathe, and energize in this dynamic bilingual class, led by Lauren Norton, designed to uplift your body and mind! Blending the strength and flow of Pilates, the rhythm and energy of dance, and the grounding presence of yoga and breathwork, this session will leave you feeling strong, balanced, and revitalized. Open to all levels, this fun and fast-paced class welcomes everyone looking to build strength, flexibility, and mindfulness in a supportive community space. This class is free, but donations for the instructor are welcome. Muévase, respire y llénese de energía en esta dinámica clase bilingüe, dirigido por Lauren Norton, diseñada para fortalecer su cuerpo y mente. Combinando la fuerza y fluidez del pilates, el ritmo y la energía de la danza, y la presencia equilibrante del yoga y la respiración, esta sesión le dejará sintiéndose fuerte, en armonía y revitalizado/a. …

item.title: [Mon, Nov 30] The Real Book Club-Jazz Standards
item.description:
🎫 KOTO 📍 Wilkinson Public Library, Telluride
Join us for The Real Book Club, a monthly jazz jam session for musicians of all levels who want to dive into classic jazz standards together! Whether you're a seasoned improviser or just starting out, this is a welcoming space to play, practice, and connect with fellow jazz enthusiasts. Each month, we’ll focus on three jazz standards selected from The Real Book. You’ll receive PDFs of the tunes in advance so you can shed at home and come ready to jam. Lead sheets will also be available on the day of the event. The songs we will play at this jam are: Once I Loved by Antonio Carlos Jobim. Here is a version I quite like with Astrud Gilberto singing. Guantanamera by Jose Fernandez Diaz. Here is a version I quite like by Joseito Fernandez. …
